interpretation: INCOMPLETE campaign: only the first two of four planned stages completed. There is one physical graph at 100k and one at 250k, not replicated graph evidence at either scale. Both stages' active-power query timing datasets are DISQUALIFIED and quarantined. Host logs report battery operation during both stages despite AC readings at run boundaries; stage 2 also contains host sleep intervals. No query latency or performance comparison is published here. Verified retrieval quality and source-exact density are retained as descriptive checkpoint evidence, not final findings or completion of the planned matched four-stage campaign.
limitations: Same fixed 200 queries and all five technical repetitions retained; 60000 calls are not independent samples.
Synthetic fixed-anchor block-balanced metadata, one inherited assignment; not semantic labels.
Modes share a graph within each stage; scale contrasts have different graphs and chronological confounding.
No repeat graph at either scale; no completed counterbalanced four-stage campaign.
Top-40 exact-neighbor counts proxy local density; they are not HNSW candidate sets or visit counts.
Descriptive rank associations use average ranks and null for constant vectors; no significance tests.
Quality and source-distance verification do not validate the disqualified active-power timing regime.
